workflow.name: PILLAR LINAW Codification Pipeline
workflow.revision: v2.1 (2026-08-09): module-isolated workflow definition (split edition); standalone SKU in both directions; LINAW owns ingestion + linaw_ordinances library; L1 export per docs/INTERCHANGE-SPEC.md

agents.name: Inventory Analyst
agents.description: Computes inventory completeness and year gaps

agents.name: Code Assembler
agents.description: Builds hierarchical Code of Ordinances with TOC

callbacks.onAgentStart: Set agent status to 'processing'; apply glow class + animate-pulse-glow
callbacks.onAgentComplete: Set status to 'completed'; show output preview; if output.hitlRequired then set status to 'hitl' and pause
callbacks.onHitlRequired: Pause pipeline; add rose-bordered HITL card to activity feed with Review/Confirm/Edit actions
callbacks.onHumanDecision: Resume pipeline (confirm/edit) or terminate branch (reject); persist decision to agent_decisions
callbacks.onPipelineComplete: Set isProcessing=false; glow output icon; add success activity
callbacks.onError: Set status to 'error'; log error; offer retry once then escalate to HITL

data_rules: Ingestion is LINAW-owned: bulk import / scan upload (own OCR) / manual entry write to linaw_ordinances; agents only see library_status='ready' records
Inventory reads only linaw_ordinances with library_status='ready' — never any other module's tables
Code Classifier uses the library's own subject metadata as priors
Cross-Reference Scanner links ordinance numbers found in text to linaw_ordinances records
Conflict Detector compares sections under the same subject
Code Assembler renumbers sections and emits JSON + TOC
All reads/writes target LINAW-owned tables only (linaw_ordinances, codification_records, ordinance_relationships, code_volumes, agent_decisions module-scoped rows)
L1 interchange export (POST /api/linaw/export-package) follows docs/INTERCHANGE-SPEC.md exactly
exception_rules: Orphan reference (target not in linaw_ordinances library) -> warning 'missing target'
Conflicting statuses on same ordinance -> error; human resolution required
Multiple amendment chains -> warning; visualize chain
Relationship confidence <0.6 -> HITL gate with side-by-side comparison
OCR timeout >60s on scan upload -> error; retry once; then HITL manual entry

pipeline_layout.input_bookend: Brain icon, cyan glow when processing
pipeline_layout.output_bookend: Database icon, green glow on completion

activity_feed.empty_state: No activities yet. Start a pipeline to see results.
